Interface TransactionHandlerBuilder

All Superinterfaces:
Handler, TransactionHandler
public interface TransactionHandlerBuilder extends TransactionHandler
Fluent builder for configuring a factory-built transaction handler with optional lifecycle hooks. Obtained from TransactionHandlerFactory.createTransactionHandler(java.lang.String, java.lang.Class<T>, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, io.kaleido.workflowengine.sdk.stage.ActionConfig<T>>).
